item.description:
Formula 0.1.52

  • Shipping: a pull request opens with its comments, checks and the agent's conversation, and you can reply, resolve and direct the agent there (#88)
  • Updates: Install and Relaunch always installs; agents carry on when Formula reopens (#87)
  • Settings: opening Settings no longer quits the app (#86)
  • Ideas: an agent that was working when Formula closed carries on from where it stopped (#85)
  • Updates download from a branch that is replaced each release, so the releases repo stops growing (#84)
  • Ideas: small ideas are planned and checked in proportion, and the sign-off note says who did what (#83)
  • Formula opens on its new screens; View > Use the Classic Screens goes back (#82)
  • Ideas: a drawing that was finished when Formula closed is not drawn again (#81)
  • Ideas: a first drawing is shown while it is being checked, and the Design progress moves on to the check (#80)
